patterns.note: Full-width sections with varied background treatments (solid colors, large photography) contain content constrained to a central max-width container.
A strong brand palette of red and yellow is consistently used for calls to action, key branding elements, and accents, contrasting against a neutral base of black, white, and various shades of grey.

The entire top header area, including the main navigation and the prominent search bar, becomes sticky and remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls. Simultaneously, the hero section's background image scrolls at a slower rate, creating a parallax effect.
Feature sections frequently utilize large, aspirational photography as full-bleed backgrounds or within card-like layouts, paired with concise descriptive text and clear calls to action.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that includes both the primary navigation and a persistent search interface, ensuring it remains fixed at the top of the screen. For the hero section, use a background image that scrolls at a reduced speed relative to the foreground content, creating a sense of depth. Content sections are structured with full-width background images or solid colors, containing centered content blocks that use a grid or card-based layout for features and information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger than body text (e.g., H1 ~3-4x body), with a clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounding on buttons, input fields, and some card elements
design_tokens.spacing: balanced spacing throughout, with generous vertical padding between sections and within the hero, becoming denser in feature grids and forms

standout: The site's strong, consistent brand identity, particularly the prominent use of the KOA red and yellow, integrated seamlessly into the design for CTAs and key information, makes the site instantly recognizable and action-oriented. The persistent, highly functional search bar within the sticky header is also a key feature.
